name: sentinel-workbench-alan-vo
workflows: Ingest multi-session agent trajectories and segment them using semantic topic-cohesion and failure-episode slicing versus fixed-token windows
Execute situation-based hybrid retrieval (BM25 + dense n-gram cosine similarity + failure-turn retention weighting) with token savings estimation over raw grep scans
Run preregistered retrieval evaluation benchmarks comparing topic-sliced vs fixed-window recall@1, MRR, Wilson confidence intervals, and candidate-pool mask integrity checks
